head_commit.message: Add contact information section to README

Add seasonal README section themes

Update the seasonal script to rotate README headings, notes, and skill labels for each theme while preserving profile content. Document the v7 behavior and compatibility.

Enhance seasonal card decorations

Add animated themed borders, labels, motifs, and light strands to the seasonal Corsica and goals SVGs. Update the seasonal guide for the new previews and clarify that Snake colors remain separate.

Apply seasonal themes to profile graphics

Update the seasonal workflow to theme the existing header, Corsica card, goals graphic, and Snake palette, with optional workflow previews. Replace the standalone seasonal banners with themed graphic variants and document the new calendar and usage.

Add GitHub contribution snake

This change adds a scheduled GitHub Actions workflow that generates animated contribution snake SVGs and publishes them to the output branch. The README now embeds the generated snake image with light/dark theme variants so the contribution graph is visible on the profile page.

Organize generated assets in img and stats

The GitHub Action now stores generated quote data and images in dedicated img/ and stats/ folders, and README references were updated to the new paths. This keeps generated artifacts out of the repo root and makes the automation easier to maintain and review.

Enhance workflow for daily quotes and README update

Updated the workflow to include top quotes generation and SVG chart creation. Adjusted timezone handling for timestamps and modified the README update process to include new top quotes.
